### Dropped in a Slave Soapland

#### A series by Attackers

"Dropped in a Slave Soapland" (Japanese: 奴●ソープに堕ちた○○) is an ongoing series by Attackers, starting in May 2010 with RBD-195, starring Nao Mizuki, and (so far) ending in December 2020 with RBD-997, starring Nozomi Haneda (aka Nozomi Hatsuki).

The title explains pretty much how this works. A woman is taken out of her ordinary life (often as a housewife), in order to serve in a soapland.
